text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT — service `redwood-prod-api` triggered paging rule 'critical' -> Paging 2 targets
pd-bot: Page fired to schedules `prod-oncall` and `contractors-shift` (unexpected duplicate binding detected)
leo: I just got paged as a contractor. I shouldn't be on prod pages. Anyone change PD bindings?
tessa: yep same, contractor phone lit up. Oncall UI shows two schedules for the same service.
jordan: I'm taking this — acking to stop further noise. @pd-bot can you dump the recent binding events?
pd-bot: Recent binding events for service `redwood-prod-api` (most recent first):
```
2026-03-14T02:00:12Z oncall-syncer bound 'redwood-prod-api' -> 'contractors-shift'
2026-03-14T02:00:12Z oncall-syncer bound 'redwood-prod-api' -> 'prod-oncall'
2026-03-14T02:00:13Z user.claire removed binding 'redwood-prod-api' -> 'contractors-shift'
```
leo: that timestamp is suspicious — 02:00:12Z is exactly when DST cron ran. Our nightly `oncall-syncer` runs at local 02:00. Looks like a DST shift caused duplicate rows.
tessa: can someone unbind `contractors-shift` from that service asap? Contractors shouldn't receive this page.
jordan: doing unbind now — will run PD CLI and then send a test page.
```
# jordan running
pdctl service unbind --service redwood-prod-api --schedule contractors-shift --note "remove accidental duplicate binding from DST sync"
```
jordan: unbind complete. Triggering a controlled test page to `prod-oncall` only.
incident-bot: TEST PAGE -> sent to `prod-oncall` only (contractors not included)
sara: Confirmed: only prod-oncall got the test. Contractors did not receive pages.
mike: quick RCA notes: `oncall-syncer` didn't dedupe schedule ids in its job when clocks moved forward. The job created two bindings for the same service with different schedule instance ids.
leo: mitigation checklist: 1) pin sync job to UTC, 2) add dedupe in syncer (by service id + schedule canonical id), 3) add DB uniqueness constraint or check, 4) add an automated canary that asserts binding_count(service) <= 1 for critical services.
tessa: I'm opening an infra ticket and assigning to infra-oncall.
```
Title: oncall-syncer: duplicate PD bindings during DST window
Assignee: infra-sync-team
Priority: P2
Notes: add UTC pin, dedupe, DB check, PD audit alert
```
jordan: also requesting a PD audit alert: when binding_count > 1 for any service, send alert to infra/sync team and page only once.
mike: I'll put up a PR to run the cron under `TZ=UTC` and add a `UNIQUE(service_id, canonical_schedule_id)` constraint on the sync table. I'll include unit tests for dedupe.
leo: great — also add a follow-up to the postmortem to include timeline + list of impacted pages (so we can reach out to any affected contractors/customers).
pd-bot: Incident status: resolved — no active pages; contractors unbound. Escalation history: none.
incident-bot: Closing incident thread 2160001111 (duplicate binding during DST). Please update the ticket with deployment/PR links once done. :white_check_mark:
